description: Live "from" prices for upcoming concerts, sport, theatre and festivals, checked hourly from StubHub listings by NeedATicket.co.uk (each UK and US event page rechecks every 5 minutes). Prices are per ticket in GBP before the seller's fees. Use it for questions like "cheapest Oasis tickets", "what's on in Manchester next weekend" or "how much are Metallica Sphere tickets". Every result links to the event's page on NeedATicket.co.uk, which shows the current price, other dates and where to buy. An event page's price can be refreshed live on demand; priceCheckedAt says when it was last read.

anywhere.description: Include events in every country, not only this site's home country. Default true when a query is given; a city with no events at home is also looked for abroad.

event_city.description: Only events held in this town or city, as named in the question, e.g. "london", "las-vegas". Not the user's own location.

from.description: First event date to include, YYYY-MM-DD (the event's local date).

max_price.description: Highest "from" price per ticket, in GBP.

query.description: Artist, team, show or venue name. Part of a word is fine.

sort.description: price = cheapest first; soon = soonest first; drop = biggest 7-day price fall; low = furthest below its usual price.

to.description: Last event date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: search_ticket_prices
title: Search live ticket prices
